title: Cisco Nexus 3000 Series NX-OS Release Notes, Release 10.2(4)M

observations.description: Some static bfd session is removed after reload. Symptom: The symptoms are as follows: · Configure under Nexus 3548: ip route static bfd Ethernet1/44 X.X.X.2 ip route static bfd Ethernet1/45 Y.Y.Y.2 interface Ethernet1/44 bfd interval 300 min_rx 300 multiplier 3 interface Ethernet1/45 bfd interval 300 min_rx 300 multiplier 3 · Before reload, there are two bfd sessions for static route: N3548C# show bfd neighbors OurAddr NeighAddr LD/RD RH/RS Holdown(mult) State Int X.X.X.1 X.X.X.2 1090519041/1 Up 4551(3) Up Eth1/44 Y.Y.Y.1 Y.Y.Y.2 1090519042/36 Up 5115(3) Up Eth1/45 · After reload, there is only one bfd session for Eth1/44, and removed for Eth1/45: N3548C# show bfd neighbors OurAddr NeighAddr LD/RD RH/RS Holdown(mult) State Int X.X.X.1 X.X.X.2 1090519041/1 Up 4530(3) Up Eth1/44 Workaround: Configure default interface configuration and re-configure.

Nexus 3548 - Boot times increased after upgrade to Cisco NX-OS Release 9.3(6). Symptom: After upgrade from Cisco NX-OS Release 9.3(5) to 9.3(6), boot times have increase from 20-40 seconds. Workaround: None

Nexus 9500-R/Nexus 3600-R hardware application counters may get corrupted. Symptom: Nexus 9500-R/Nexus 3600-R running Cisco NX-OS 9.3(x) version of converged code may experience hardware counter corruption causing specific application counters to show incorrect information. Workaround: Reload clears the issue, but it can resurface.
Nexus 9500-R/Nexus 3600-R CoPP incorrectly matches fragmented UDP packet with UDP PTP port payload as PTP packet. Symptom: PTP CoPP class shows drops. Workaround: None
“use-vrf management” is missing from the "logging server" configuration line in running config. Symptom: "use-vrf management" is missing from the output of the show run command. Workaround: None

Nexus 9000/Nexus 3100/Nexus 3500 may be sending out of spec PTP messages with SourcePortID equal to zero. Symptom: Nexus PTP messages rejected by third-party PTP device. Workaround: Do not use port 1 for PTP.

PBR over GRE feature broken on Nexus 3000 platform. Symptom: Per the Cisco Nexus 3000 NX-OS Interfaces Configuration Guide for 9.3(x), Nexus 3000 supports “Configuring a Tunnel Interface Based on Policy Based Routing”. However, when the PBR sets next-hop ip with the tunnel local ip, the PBR IPv4 nexthop table does not install the tunnel IP. Workaround: None

OSPFv3 neighborship is brought down when issuing "no feature nv overlay" and when authentication is used. Symptom: When you enable feature nv overlay on Nexus 3000 and then disable it by issuing "no feature nv overlay," all existing OSPFv3 neighborships are going to DOWN state. Workaround: Remove OSPFv3 authentication under interface.

Nexus 3500 fails to update L2 ltl-index for some mcast groups due to exhausted ltl-index pool. Symptom: After igmp report is received by Nexus 3000, mtc does not program the OIF into l2-ltl. Workaround: None; reload the switch to recover.
